name: How do I choose a contractor for my garage conversion ADU project?
description: Choose a contractor with ADU experience, local code knowledge, proper licensing, good references, and transparent communication.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for my garage conversion ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for your garage conversion ADU, look for one with specific experience in ADU construction and a strong understanding of local zoning and building codes in your area (e.g., Orange, Yorba Linda). Check for proper licensing, insurance, and a portfolio of completed projects. Ask for references and read client testimonials to assess their reliability, communication, and quality of work. A transparent bidding process and a clear contract are also important indicators of a professional contractor. We pride ourselves on our specialized ADU expertise and customer satisfaction.
